items.title: A locally constant sheaf of modules on a connected scheme is constant after an etale covering
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that a locally constant sheaf of Lambda-modules on a connected scheme X is constant on some etale covering (statement lines 10083-10089). The non-formal content is the grouping step: one must define I_M = {i | M_i is isomorphic to M}, observe that U_i x_X U_j is empty whenever M_i and M_j are not isomorphic (proof lines 10095-10096), and then use openness of etale morphisms to make U_M = union of the images Im(U_i -> X) an open subset (proof lines 10097-10099). Connectedness then forces exactly one open piece to be nonempty, which is the conclusion. The claim is H2: one explicit construction and a short connectedness argument.
